HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
Date: 07-06-2020
User Guide - Online Mentioning Platform
[Ref. Circular dated 04-06-2020]
1. From High Court website https://gujarathighcourt.nic.in/ , please
click on Case Status/Judgments/Orders link on the right side of the
page. This link can also be directly accessed from
http://gujarathc-casestatus.nic.in/gujarathc/.
2. From there, please click on the Mentioning icon
3. The online mentioning will be accepted from 9.00 am to 10.00 am
on Court Working days. The mentioning platform will work during
only such duration.
4. Learned Advocate should enter
his/her Advocate Code in the input
box given as follows:
5. An OTP will be
generated and
sent in SMS to
his/her
registered
mobile number.
After entering
the correct
OTP, the
following input
screen form will
appear:
User Guide - Online Mentioning Platform - Gujarat High Court Page 1/2
6. Either Registration or Filing details are to be entered in the screen
as given above. I. A. s can also be selected through this entry box.
Only the matters wherein the concerned Advocate code is
updated, will be accepted for mentioning.
7. After entering the case details of the matter to be mentioned and
CAPTCHA [String Verification] shown on the screen, please click
on SUBMIT button.
8. The mentioning platform will confirm through a dialogue box on the
screen that the matter has been noted for mentioning before the
designated Honourable Judge on the same day.
9. Zoom video conferencing link will be sent on the registered mobile
number of the learned advocate who applied for mentioning, when
the Honourable Judge takes up mentioning during the day.
